agentAbility.name: Electro Vision
agentAbility.description: Activate an electromagnetic scanning field to make every enemy within a 500m radius Traced for you for a short time.

agentTrait.name: Overpenetration
agentTrait.description: After penetrating the first target, your shells continue flying with reduced damage and penetration until it hits a second target within a certain distance.

primaryAttack.name: Autoloader
primaryAttack.description: Allows firing several shots within a short time interval, after that, takes some time to reload empty drum.

tankAbilities.name: Impulse Shot
tankAbilities.description: Special kinetic rod projectile that on hit deals medium damage and violently displaces the enemy tank in the direction of travel.

tankAbilities.name: Scout Drone
tankAbilities.description: Shooting scout drone from the turret that player can guide. It explodes on first impact and leaves every enemy identified in the area of effect.
